+I tried
target.getStateCounter(stateID)
and encountered another problem.
Lets set up that
origin.level
is 1 and
target.getStateCounter(10)
is "0" (there is no state on the target)
According to formula, it should go like this:
1 * (0 / 5 + 1) * 1
which is
1 * (0 + 1) * 1
which is
1 * 1 * 1
which is 1 damage in the end.
But game gives me double 0 as the result damage, which doesn't happen when there IS some count of state's stacks
Picture. First enemy have 6 stacks, other's 0 and there are these results of calculating.
Log says 6 stacks for the first enemy and "unidentified" for others ("black hole" state is that one DoT effect which takes a number of stacks of other effect). I guess I have to tell the game if there are no any of this effect - the value is 0. Maybe it will fix the problem? Or not?
EDIT: I fixed it.

For your apply effect. the issue if any would be shards. if the target doesnt have state 10, then itd be undefined and any math used with it would be NaN. you were right in adding the || 0 to it. the numItems doesnt need it, but its just not going to do anything. it wont cause a problem
the issue in your regenerate effect is that neither shards nor flowers would be defined. variables dont exist outside the notetag you made them in. you would have to redefine them there, or else your damage will be NaN if the battler has the state but didnt get a _newSpace written onto them
